captions.detailed: This is a dual-screen casino slot cabinet with a dark grey and black finish. It features a tall main lower screen, a smaller secondary upper screen, a slanted button deck with illuminated orange buttons, and a bill-acceptor door on the lower front. The bill-acceptor door is functional and rotates on a vertical hinge, while the individual orange play buttons can be pressed down as prismatic sliders.
captions.instruction: Generate a dual-screen casino slot cabinet with a tall lower display, an upper display, and a slanted button deck featuring orange play buttons. Incorporate a functional, hinged bill-acceptor door on the lower front panel and make the play buttons articulate as independent prismatic controls.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body using combined CSG box primitives with chamfered and extruded side wings. Model the screens as thin boxes recessed into the frame. Build the bill-acceptor door as a separate part connected to the main body via a revolute joint rotating around a vertical axis. Create the play buttons as individual prismatic parts arranged along the slanted deck using a linear pattern, constrained to slide along their local vertical axes.
